content.text: Implement ISSUE-0003 - Compute the Ledger total in integer cents.

content.thinking: Floating point cannot represent money, so the total accumulates integer cents and only the CLI formats them for display.

input.content: export function totalCents(store) { return store.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.amount_cents, 0) }

content.text: Ledger.total sums integer cents, never floats, and returns 0 on an empty ledger. Gate gate:test:ledger-total is green.
